evidence: Adds a GitHub Actions Guix CI workflow (`.github/workflows/guix.yml`) and modifies Guix build scripts in `contrib/guix/libexec/`.
rationale: Testing Guix release packages continuously in CI addresses the release integrity gap where toolchain and manifest regressions currently go unnoticed until manual release time. Reviewers note this compilation in a release context catches issues currently missed and helps validate work like static toolchains (#25573).
